title: Concept: Conan lock on an older format
description: conan.lock declares a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conan.lock (conan).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format.
